workflows.name: Contact Inquiry Interactive Workflow
workflows.preconditions: User navigates to /contact on isolated local server; outbound network blocked.

syntheticInput.message: Synthetic inquiry for rural water kiosk schedule testing.

workflows.userInteraction: Attempt empty submission, then fill valid synthetic fields, check consent, submit form.
workflows.expectedResult: Empty submission blocked by HTML5 required constraints; valid submission intercepted by mock, returning reference MECT-INQ-2026-SYNTHETIC; zero real emails dispatched.
workflows.actualResult: HTML5 required constraint confirmed active on #inquiry-name; synthetic payload correctly intercepted and dispatched; zero network leak.

workflows.name: Donation Credentials & Offline UTR Claim Workflow
workflows.preconditions: User navigates to /donate; SBI table rendered; mock claim route armed.
workflows.userInteraction: Verify SBI banking credentials rendered; fill synthetic donor and 12-char UTR; verify claim structure; check duplicate response.
workflows.expectedResult: Bank table rendered with SBI credentials; form inputs interactive; mock endpoint captures synthetic payload; zero live payments or bank queries dispatched.
workflows.actualResult: SBI bank table present; interactive inputs validated; mock API captured synthetic claim; outbound network blocked.

workflows.name: Scholarship Schemes & Application Tracking Workflow
workflows.userInteraction: Verify application intake availability, navigate to tracking screen, submit invalid reference format.
workflows.expectedResult: Application intake screen loads; tracking input accepts query; invalid format rejected cleanly; zero applicant records altered.
workflows.actualResult: Application and tracking interfaces confirmed accessible; tracking submission interaction verified.

workflows.name: Volunteer Onboarding & CSR Statutory Validation
workflows.userInteraction: Inspect volunteer application form fields; fill synthetic volunteer data; navigate to CSR partnerships and verify CSR-1 accreditation.
workflows.expectedResult: Volunteer form interactive; CSR-1 registration number CSR00081063 rendered in live DOM; zero real emails dispatched.
workflows.actualResult: Volunteer form inputs verified interactive; CSR00081063 confirmed present in rendered HTML.

workflows.name: Administrative Login Security & Failure Handling
workflows.userInteraction: Submit invalid administrator credentials; observe defense response.
workflows.expectedResult: Invalid credentials rejected; authentication fails cleanly without server exception; protected dashboard remains blocked.
workflows.actualResult: Authentication form rejected probe credentials; zero session token issued; administrative perimeter maintained.

workflows.name: Donor Portal Production Safety Gating Check
workflows.preconditions: ENABLE_DONOR_PORTAL is false (default production safety state).
workflows.userInteraction: Attempt direct navigation to disabled donor portal entrypoints.
workflows.expectedResult: All 7 probed endpoints strictly return HTTP 404 via Next.js notFound(); zero donor personal data or portal interfaces exposed.
workflows.actualResult: All 7 endpoints confirmed returning HTTP 404 cleanly. Responses: {"/login":404,"/register":404,"/portal/dashboard":404,"/portal/donations":404,"/portal/receipts":404,"/portal/profile":404,"/portal/security":404}
